what: Only a vertical tab (70px) sticks out from the right edge of the screen, with a white panel hidden behind it. Clicking the tab slides the panel out over .5s to show a table inside (such as opening hours). Clicking outside the panel, pressing Esc, or clicking the tab slides it back in. With show set, it appears over .5s only after scrolling down by that amount (past the Hero). The ”bottom” type shows only the head of the menu panel (the MENU row) at the bottom right, and the whole panel rises when clicked. Scrolling closes it, and it drops 110% down when it reaches Contact or the Footer.

options.show: Distance in px to scroll before the tab appears. With a selector, it shows once that element’s bottom edge passes the top of the screen. Without one, it shows from the start.
options.hide: Selector (or px) — when the top edge of that element touches the hide-at line, it hides again (closes if open)
options.hide-at: hide line — share of screen height (0 = On screen, 1 = bottom of screen), default 0
options.close: with scroll, it closes on every scroll
options.look: bottom — a menu tab that sticks out from the bottom edge by the --fx-tab height (right --fx-inset, default 4rem)
options.--fx-tab: Tab width left when hidden (height for bottom type) (via style), default 70px
options.--fx-dur: Length of the push-out/appear motion (via style), default .5s
options.--fx-inset: Right offset of the bottom Type (via style), default 4rem
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Pressed tab (child) — first child of the panel. When open, the panel gets is-fx-open and the tab gets aria-expanded

note: bottom type, e.g.: <nav data-fx="peek-tab" data-fx-peek-tab="look: bottom; show: #hero; hide: #contact; close: scroll" style="--fx-tab: 6.8rem; --fx-dur: .3s">

from.where: shared.js .aa-sch (right-side ”Opening hours” tab and schedule panel that appear after passing the hero)

shared.js .a-menu.is-clone (after the Hero, a menu panel that pushes out only the 6.8rem MENU head at bottom right — .3s, closes on scroll, hides when the Contact header reaches the top of the screen)
from.options: look: bottom; show: [data-slot=hero]; hide: .js-contact-head; close: scroll; --fx-tab: 6.8rem; --fx-dur: .3s
